description: This is a JUnit test class for the GlobalCommandResponseRegistry, testing its ability to register command types, parse JSON objects into command responses, and handle exceptions properly.

classes.name: GlobalCommandResponseRegistryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the functionality of GlobalCommandResponseRegistry.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the registry instance and headers before each test.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryKnowsJsonTypeTestCommand
methods.description: Tests whether the registry correctly recognizes the command response type.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryParsesTestJsonObject
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object with a specified type is properly parsed into a command response object.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryWrapsExceptionInDittoJsonException
methods.description: Verifies that parsing an invalid JSON object throws an appropriate DittoJsonException.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryThrowsJsonTypeNotParsableException
methods.description: Confirms that providing an unrecognized type throws a JsonTypeNotParsableException.
